note.en: The chosen option first rolls success or one of two rejections (e.g. 70/20/10); on success hidden 3303 picks the patron weighted by the empire's leanings; the End of the Cycle has base weight 2.

utopia.3302.zh: 交流遭拒：失去一名领袖

notes.zh: 审阅说明：这是可重复的联络入口（降灵会后首次自动打开，此后通过外交界面联络虚境）。仅在未拥有“虚境之影”DLC时启用（has_shroud_dlc = no）；本地安装的DLC目录中没有该DLC。每次深入扣除能量并加2160天冷却（受修正影响），冷却中联络只会看到“虚境（冷却中）”。
notes.en: Review note: a repeatable contact entry (opened automatically after the Séance, afterwards via diplomacy with the Shroud). Active only without the Shadows of the Shroud DLC (has_shroud_dlc = no); that DLC is not among the installed DLC folders. Each delve costs energy and adds a 2160-day cooldown (modifiable); contacting during the cooldown shows only 'The Shroud (cooldown)'.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：魂灵之月窠的契约不在本线（3303）可选的守护者中，只见于“虚境之影”内容。
notes.en: Review note: the Cradle of Souls is not among the patrons this line (3303) can offer; it belongs to Shadows of the Shroud content.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：魂灵之月窠的契约副作用，只见于“虚境之影”内容。
notes.en: Review note: a Cradle of Souls side effect; only reachable with Shadows of the Shroud content.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：魂灵之月窠的契约副作用，只见于“虚境之影”内容。
notes.en: Review note: a Cradle of Souls side effect; only reachable with Shadows of the Shroud content.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：通过“与不可名状者交流”项目缔结的契约（tradition_covenant）先只获得初级修正；完成灵能传统后360天才出现本事件，确认后开始契约事件链与等级增长。
notes.en: Review note: a covenant formed through the 'Commune with the Ineffable' project (tradition_covenant) first grants only the initial modifier; this event comes 360 days after completing the Psionics traditions, and confirming starts the covenant chain and rank growth.

scope.zh: 虚境全线：突入虚境传统→项目→降灵会→可重复的虚境入口；首次深入、幻象池、恩赐/诅咒、化身、契约（两条缔结路线、确认、等级1–4、副作用）、天选之帝、轮回之终末与最终清算。
scope.en: The whole Shroud line: Breach the Shroud tradition → project → Séance → repeatable Shroud contact; first delve, vision pool, boons/curses, Avatars, covenants (two ways to form, confirmation, ranks 1–4, side effects), the Divine Sovereign, the End of the Cycle and the Reckoning.

uncertain: Shroud Incursion (utopia.3024) can also be fired by Shadows of the Shroud content (shroud.13000); not reviewed here.

The Reckoning aftermath docs from events/shroud_events.txt (shroud.11225/11235/11255/11260) are shared with origin_endbringers and were only checked for how this line reaches them; RECKONING_ARRIVAL_PROJECT is enabled by 3320 regardless of DLC.
Exact covenant rank timing depends on save state (civics, ethics, traditions, war); only thresholds and monthly increments are documented.
